name: Rascal

fursona.description: Rascal is an anthro raccoon with a distinctive presence. He coloring is lilac skin, coral gills; his eyes are pale green. He lives in a small flat near the old tram line. Rascal keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Rascal (Trevor Mills) is a man anthro raccoon, born 1960-04-02, with recycling attendant as his work situation. Methodical and dryly funny, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Rascal is methodical and dryly funny. He notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Tilts their head while listening.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around his late schedule.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him notice details, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Rascal enjoys watercolor and ambient music. He remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Rascal while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about watercolor becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Rascal. His gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; he is an anthro raccoon. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Rascal's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable during daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
